description: Use this before authoring an unfamiliar field instead of probing validate_chart for errors. Returns the JSON Schema for the whole Szum document, covering config, data, presentation, size, and output, with every referenced definition included. Pass chart_type to keep only that family's config variants; omitting it returns every family and is much larger. Generated value lists are summarized rather than enumerated; validate_chart remains the authority.

chart_type.description: Keep only the config variants for this chart type. Pass it whenever the family is known.

name: get_schema
title: Get chart document schema
